requirements.statement: The ecosystem manifest is the canonical registry of systems, repositories, governance roles, and authorities.
The dependency graph records contract version and certification gate for every registered system.
Every dependency edge references registered systems and every system has exactly one authoritative governance role.
ThreatFade Web, FDE Mastery, Tinlance.com, Agent Developer, and FAS-Bench are explicitly represented where applicable.
The lock policy denies unregistered systems, authority conflicts, contract drift, unsupported commercial claims, and downstream certification before upstream green gates.
TSIC does not acquire consequential execution authority; Agent Platform remains the generic consequential execution authority.
Certification status is serial: downstream phases cannot be certified when an upstream phase is not green.
Repository and architecture documentation are reconciled to the canonical phase registry.
